## What lives here
The file-based routes (pages) of TanStack Router; `routeTree.gen.ts` is generated from them.

## Conventions
Flat dotted names (`agents.$id.tsx`); a trailing `_` makes a route non-nested; `index` is the index route.

## Entry points
`__root.tsx` (shell and auth gate).
